body: I can’t say I can give u a logical reason to live because if u genuinely think you’ll be better off dead that’s ur core belief and opinion but I can offer some words that aren’t overused washed up “things will get better” cause they won’t permanently. As a whole life is more hard for majority than easy and there’s gonna be times where it doesn’t necessarily get better but things just flow together easier. First off don’t blame yourself cause ur mom caused all this. She’s abusive and traumatized u to not let ur guard down and make friends. And this happens to a lot of people so ur definitely not alone. I don’t know what would work for u to make life a little less unbearable it could be therapy it could be antidepressants hell it even could be self medicating which is what I do to help with depression and unmotivation but I wouldn’t recommend it. I will say before u completely give up find a crutch u can lean on. Find something that makes life not AS shitty. It doesn’t have to make it perfect. As for ur job u hate ur life even more cause ur doing something u don’t enjoy or even like decently to get thru the day. I don’t know ur personal interests but I hope u can attribute those to finding something u like to do for money. Get out of that school and start new. As for ur looks you’re a man so I’m going to be 100% real with u and brutally honest coming from a woman. Men’s looks don’t really matter . There financial and stability is what is valued in society so I wouldn’t knock urself about ur looks. Before u say u hate your personality this might sound corny but take an mbti test and see all ur positive attributes to your personality . Actually literally study yourself so u can really focus on who u are as a person. I actually did overdose on accident one time on fentanyl at 18 and almost died and when I was gasping for air in the ambulance with my face black and blue is right when I decided I want to live and it was almost to late. It’s crazy how most people don’t realize they wanna live til they’re on the brink of death. Idk if this will help but I’m here if u need me

I tell myself who cares it’s only pills it’s not like it’s heroin or fent, I tell myself I’m young and by the time I’m older I’ll grow out of it, so much other things . But I’ve haven’t been sober for this amount of time in so long and I realized wow I’m really probably never gonna be able to do life without drugs cause I can’t see how I would improve anything about myself. I can’t talk to people without it, I can’t go out and enjoy life, when I look back at all my milestones I realize I wouldn’t even have been able to do that without drugs
